verdict.rationale: Pigment's security page explicitly states that customer data is stored in the region the customer chooses, either europe-west3 (Frankfurt) or us-west1 (Oregon). This directly delivers the region/residency choice the story asks for. Missing for 10: only two regions are offered, there are no in-depth docs on how the region is selected or migrated (or on AI-agent/MCP data-processing locality), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
